notes.title: Update Status
notes.notes:
Well well well, it's been a while hasn't it.
In fact well over a year since the last news!

But I am here today to tell you this project is still being worked on!
It's still going to take a while before I can release an update, but that's because I've [strike]broken everything[/strike] been pushing the game engine to it's limits!

With the lighting overhaul from the last announcement, I wanted to also improve other aspect of the games visuals an audio.

Did you know that lighting doesn't work too well when going diagonally? Turns out that was a rather interesting visual! 
But I got that fixed! 

Additionally I wanted to make ambient sounds more immersive. So... after much trial and error I sounds to be location based... sort of. They just get louder the closer you are. I never managed to get them to be directional.

Up Next we have messages! They will now no longer be a boring box at the bottom of the screen, but will now show above the character that's talking, which is also very useful to know which character is talking in scenes. 

Additionally, I've been looking back over the reviews and posts to identify other areas that needed fixing up.

A common complaint was the battle system being too fast. Now, we do have the "Wait" battle mode that does address this, but I will also be looking at balancing the battles to make it so playing on Semi-Active and Full Active are not a constant barrage of actions so you as the player can have time to think and act on whats going on.

If you have any suggestions or other feedback please let me know in the comments!

notes.title: Lighting Overhaul In Next Release
notes.notes:
As part of the rework, I wanted to ensure that the lighting system was used more effectively. 

Currently the Lighting system is hardly used outside of a few small areas, however with the new update in the works I wanted to make the lighting of the work feel more unique. 

As such I have completely changed the lighting system, as well as removed the unused day/night system.

Below is a screenshot of an area in the new version, On the left you can see the old (current) lighting system, and on the right, the new lighting. 

There is no current planned public release at this time, however this will be release on the beta channel within the next few weeks.

notes.title: 2022 Updates!
notes.notes:
It's time for one of those Update posts that I hear people like!
Let’s start with a Quality-of-Life change, The Fullscreen and Fit Screen functions have been overhauled to now work seamlessly together!
You will now be able to switch between the different window sizes using F5 (To Toggle Fullscreen modes) F6 (To toggle window / game size) and F7 (To toggle Fit Screen Mode)

In the current version, Fullscreen and Fit Screen come hand in hand, meaning when you enable Fullscreen it will force fit screen. 
In the next version, Fullscreen will auto-enable Fit Screen, however you can disable this and still toggle the “Play Area” using F6

Next, the F12 Reset button has been fully disabled so that it doesn’t clash with Steams default “Take Screenshot” button. 

Now, on to the game changes.
I am about 1% of the way though the game overhaul. Although the area’s haven’t changed that much the story like has been tweaked to feel more in line with the overall story, This includes removing some fights and making the story flow a lot better without sending the player back to Karo Town like 500 times. 
Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Status Update - 2021
notes.notes:
So it's 2021 and... well there're not been an update in forever. 

I know. I've been promising and update for a while now but as I'm sure you are all aware, 2020 was a bit of a bad year for following plans.

So, here is the news!

Game status: Still In Progress. (Yes I haven't forgotten about, or given up on it)

What's The Plan:
So, here's the "bad" news. I have decided to overhaul the game and start from zero. Now, you might be asking why, and I have 2 reason.

First, the current state of the game is kind of a mess. This is because as the game was developed, changes were made to the story and these didn't always get retro fixed to the existing content.

And second, there was never really a plan with this game. This whole project actually started a test project that I never planned to release, however as I was testing ideas they all seemed to fit together, and that's how the project started.

So, whats going to happen?

Well the story will be re-written from the ground up, some lore will change, and a lot of areas will be re-designed. 

Once that has all be done, at least up to the point of the last update (that was never fully finished, sorry) an update will be pushed to Early Access, old saves will no longer work, however all DLC will still be available to players via the quest book as normal.

TL;DR
The game is getting overhauled... Jessie vented in admin and Mike is acting sus so Sophie has called an emergency meeting.

notes.title: No Updates In Over A Year?
notes.notes:
With over a year with no real updates, new or content I wouldn't blame you for thinking the game is dead and buried, but I can assure you that it is not. 

Over the last year or so I have had a lot happen, from a new job that takes up more of my time, to some health issues (nothing major).

As well as that the content I have created for the game just felt Sub-par and didn't meet the vision I had when starting the project. There is a new update that is in the works, however as this is something I can only work on part-time, and I want to make sure that it is as awesome as I can make it, it is going to take some time. 
I hope to be more active with new this year, however, I can't promise anything.

I want to thank everyone interested in the game and played it, created content on YouTube/Twitch, purchased DLC, or even just shared it with their friends, and I hope to bring you something amazing soon!

That's all for now,

Cloud.

notes.title: Would you be happy starting a new game?
notes.notes:
An odd question I know, but here's the thing. I want to go back to some earlier areas of the game and tweak them. (Including Story related parts, mechanics etc) 

The issue is, If I do this then all saves will be useless. 

So there are 2 options I see here. 

1 - Continue as things are and make these changes once the game is finished. (That may take a while). (Some story aspects will have to be skipped)

2 - Make the change now and give you all the updated story, features etc but force you all to start a new game.

Vote and discuss below and I will make the decision based on what you all think. 

And, if you're not sure, just ask yourself. "What would Jessie do?"

~ CloudTheWolf

notes.title: Restore Your Missing Saves
notes.notes:
A Few users have missed the post about the File Save Location changing so here a a quck reminder. (Previous Post Here https://steamcommunity.com/app/448570/discussions/1/154645487793832326/ ) 

As of the latest update your existing saves will not show when starting the game. This is because the location we look for save games has changed.

Youi will need to move all CTWSAV2 files from the root of the game directory to "%appdata%/Origin Of Destiny/Saves" (If you don't see an origin of destiny folder start the game then quit and you should now see it, or just create it your self)

As per the below screenshot you will need to copy (Or Move) the CTWSAV2 files to the Saves folder. once done STart the game (Or quit and relaunch if the game is running) and all your saves will be restored.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12498973/76aff90a0ff239412bb20b531ddd2fa7c824986a.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12498973/619ff7e32c2dc47848e467f4ccc9a9743f98d34f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: A New Threat to Indie Game Titles
notes.notes:
So, if you have been keeping up with the Steam News, or play/support other indie titles, you may be aware of steams proposed new system for game submission. 

Here is a basic run down.
 - Steam Greenlight will be scrapped.
 - Developers will now have to pay a 1 off fee for each game
 - Initial Reports indicate it will cost anything upto $5000 per title (Although no official word yet)

And this is where the problem is. Most Developers who use Steam Greenlight are just like me. One person with a great idea for a game and the dedication to put it to plan. It could be in RPG Maker, Unity, UE4 or any engine. And it's either just them (As it is for me) or a small group. 

With this new system one of two things could happen:

1 - All Indie Devs who want to release on steam, leave the platform and go to other 3rd party sites and release their game for free there.

2 - They still publish their game on steam, but rather than it being Free or a really low price they change anything up to AAA Game prices in an attempt to turn a profit

And I know that if I was to release my game under this new system I would be planning to change between $5.99 - $9.99 (And still have the DLC) and probably not have been much of a success.

Official Post By Steam: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/558846854614253751]Evolving Steam[/url]

As a gamer, please let me know what you think of these changes and I would love to see this from the Gamers side as well as a Developers side.

- Michael Howard

notes.title: Upcoming Mini-Patch
notes.notes:
This weekend a mini-patch will be released.

Here are a few thanks that will change:

Battles:

- Some enemies will have their speed and defense reduced

- Stun rate will be reduced for Bodyslam

- Dark Rat's will have their HP Reduced 

- Some enemies will have their attacked boosted to make up for the speed loss.

- Some bosses will have their ATK/MAT Reduced and their DEF/MDF boosted

- Most Bosses will have new skills added that will be used later in the battle

- ManaHype will be a rare drop for all Slime forms (1/16 chance)

NPC's/Animals

 - New NPC's will be added to some areas to add flavor text/lore

- Move Routes will be changed for some animals as they can block the player in some areas.

Items:

- Potions will now only recover 150 HP

- Magic Water will restore 100MP

- ManaHype will be added into earlier areas as a rare find

notes.title: Yet another preview?!
notes.notes:
With the next update around the on the way very soon I thought I would share another preview!

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Cg_3GaAWkAQUTRU.jpg:large[/img]

Now the big thing most people will notice is the character portraits! These will allow you to select moves faster as you won't have to remember your party order.

But that's not all. See that Turn count in the top left. I bet you do know.
As the game has an ATB system in place instead of a turn based system a lot of "Turn" based skills seemed to work for longer than expected. 

Well no more! With an ATB system in place we have to calculate each "Turn" based a time. As such, there is now a counter in the top left of the battle screen. You can use this to plan ahead and see when an effect (Such as MP Regen) will expire. 

That's all for this pre-patch update!

More soon! :D

notes.title: WARNING: Next Update Will Not Work With Current Saves
notes.notes:
Hi All,

This is just a warning that the next update will not work with your current save. The reason for this, is a lot a script data is stored there and when loading the old save the requested data wont be found and you will get an error.

As such, Please comment below where you are in the game and I will release another save set to make sure you don't have to start over.

If I don't see any comments I will just release a save set to be at the most key points of the game. :)

Hopefully this will be the last time saves will be a problem. 

The Update will be released later today and will be the last update before the big R103 release.

notes.title: What's Happening This Week!
notes.notes:
So this week I will be focusing on setting up the plot for the next part of the game, and this is going to be very heavy on cut scenes. 

Without getting into to much detail this will give you a nice back story of Sophie, Jessie and Mike and will cover key events in their lives up to the point of the start of the game.

This Thread will help you will that. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/448570/discussions/1/371918937272460561/] Game Crashes When entering a Battle after the last update [/url]

However to give as much help without giving away any plot. Press the A button on the Keyboard instead of Z when talking to the guard from the right.

More News Soon!

~ CloudTheWolf

notes.title: Early Access Is Here!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Early Access is now live!

Here's what you need to know:

- The Early Access Release is not the full game
- While Playing Early Access There may (And most likely be) bugs
- The game may change drastically upon final release

If you don't want to play the game in Early Access that's fine. Drop in every so often to see if the game is ether released or at a point in early access you think you would enjoy the game.

If you do get involved in Early Access the There are 2 new forums to head to. EA-Bugs and EA-Suggestions. You can use these forums to let me know any issues you encounter and any ideas you may have to make the game better. 

Also there is an EA-Feedback forum as well. Use this to provide any feedback you may have. 

Have fun and stay tuned. the R-103 release is planned for this weekend! 

~CloudTheWolf

notes.title: Achievements Disabled + Missing RTP Error
notes.notes:
I have had reports from some users saying they get errors where the game crashes after beating Ifrit or completing the intro.

We have found this issue with Steam Achievements so have removed these until we get the issue fixed.

I was also informed that players could no longer run the game they did not have the RTP Data Installed. This data is bundled into the game however it looks like the game can no longer find the data.

As such a new Launch Option has been added to install the VX Ace RTP Data Standalone. 

I hope to have both issues resolved soon and will post an update once we have a resolution.

If you do find any bugs in the game let me know in the discussions!
